findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "construction-commercial" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: construction-commercial_contractor-payment-application-audit · Public sink: construction-commercial_contractor-payment-application-audit · Destructive: construction-commercial_contractor-payment-application-audit.
findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
